title: Cirrus Airframe Parachute System (CAPS) In Action
summary: Coast Guard footage of a Cirrus SR-22 pilot who ran out of fuel over the Pacific and deployed the airframe parachute, then escaped into a life raft. It shows the Cirrus Airframe Parachute System working in a real emergency.
why: Linked in aviation threads as a concrete example of the Cirrus parachute in action, including its rough touchdown.

quote.text: Here's a video of the company's piston-engined model landing under parachute in the middle of the Pacific ocean
